ALLIED HEALTH PROFESSIONS ACT 2016

ALLIED HEALTH PROFESSIONS (AMENDMENT OF SECOND SCHEDULE) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers' conferred by _ section 10 of the
Allied Health Professions Act 2016 [Act 774], the Minister, on the recommendation of

the Council, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Allied Health Professions (Amendment of
Second Schedule) Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 24 March 2022.

Substitution of Second Schedule
2. The Allied Health Professions Act 2016 is amended by substituting for the
Second Schedule the following schedule:
"SECOND SCHEDULE
[Sections 9 and 10]

LIST OF ALLIED HEALTH PROFESSIONS

1. Audiologist

2. Dietitian

3. Entomologist (Public Health)
4. Physiotherapist

5. Medical Physicist

6. Nutritionist

7. Clinical Psychologist

Diagnostic Radiographer
Medical Laboratory Scientist
Occupational Therapist
Speech-Language Therapist
Radiation Therapist

Medical Laboratory Technologist
Dental Technologist
Environmental Health Officer

Health Education Officer".

Made 21 March 2022
[KKM.PUU/R/U2/AHP JLD 7(2); PN(PU2)753]

KHAIRY JAMALUDDIN ABU BAKAR

Minister of Health
